purpose: Adapters for strict nineteenth-century society, early-geology, and Sorby experimental slide collections recovered through deep search.
guards: Separate Royal Microscopical Society and Quekett Microscopical Club holdings; they are distinct collections with different custody histories.
Preserve historical count states separately from present aggregates.
Keep experiment date publication date later loan/bequest rediscovery and current custody as separate events.

adapters.institution_scope: History of Science Museum Oxford / Royal Microscopical Society
adapters.target: Small Worlds catalogue/exhibition and microscope-slide catalogue discovery
adapters.promotion_rule: Treat the single RMS cabinet as a physical collection node and isolate 1860-1899 specimen records before historical counting.

adapters.institution_scope: Quekett Microscopical Club slide collection at NHM London
adapters.target: club archives slide database and historical collection listings
adapters.promotion_rule: Capture current aggregate and historical dated states separately; follow donated-collection listings and cabinet records without conflating QMC with RMS.

adapters.institution_scope: National Museums Scotland historical microscopy records
adapters.target: curated heritage record for early Edinburgh geological microscope slides
adapters.promotion_rule: Extract each illustrated slide's date specimen and provenance relation; preserve purchase from Nicol and Forbes-collection attribution separately.

adapters.institution_scope: University of Sheffield / South Yorkshire Industrial History Society Sorby metallurgy collections
adapters.target: annotated catalogue of extant glass-mounted metallurgical specimens
adapters.promotion_rule: Model specimen catalogue entries and the two current custody groups separately; retain later Arnold loan/bequest and 1987 rediscovery events.

adapters.institution_scope: University of Sheffield Sorby experimental preparations
adapters.target: institutional-repository article documenting the rediscovered Chemical Precipitates box
adapters.promotion_rule: Extract individual engraved slide number/date/experiment notes where available and treat conventional versus cavity slides and balsam deterioration separately.
